mass

When a mass is dropped onto the rod, the rod moves further into the sand.
A student predicts that the distance the rod moves into the sand is proportional to the mass
dropped onto the rod.
Plan an investigation to test the student’s prediction.
You are provided with:
• the apparatus in Fig. 4.1
• a number of different masses.
In your plan, include:
• any additional apparatus you will use
• a brief description of the method
• the variables you will control and the measurements you will take
• a table to record the results (you are not required to enter any readings in the table)
• how you will process your results to form a conclusion about the prediction.
